Name: Kenneth's Artifact Loot Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]This is a small addon for Kenneth's Grocery Store. It puts 42 vanilla artifacts into Shop8, so the museum collection is a lot less grindy.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get is the stuff you would normally dig up with the hoe or find in fishing chests and monster drops. Dwarf Scrolls, arrowhead, chipped amphora, ancient doll, elvish jewelry, dinosaur egg, rare disc, ancient sword, rusty spoon, spur and cog, chicken statue, ancient seed, prehistoric tool, starfish, anchor, glass shards, bone flute, handaxe, dwarvish helm, dwarf gadget, ancient drum, golden mask, golden relic, both strange dolls, and the full fossil set.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Stock is unlimited, so you can buy as many as you need for the museum or for gifts.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Grocery Store installed, since this addon only adds items to its Shop8. It also needs Content Patcher to run. There is no config and no new items, it just makes vanilla artifacts buyable.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install is the usual flow. Drop this folder into your Mods folder together with Kenneth's Grocery Store, then start the game. If Shop8 is empty for you, check that the base Grocery Store mod is enabled first.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made for players who already finished most of the farm and just want to fill in the last few museum slots without spending another season digging.[/b][/size]

Manifest.Name: Kenneth's Artifact Loot Addon
Manifest.Description: Adds Artifact Loot (Dwarf Scrolls, Fossils, Relics and Museum Artifacts) to Kenneth's Grocery Store Shop8. Requires Kenneth's Grocery Store.
